title: alsinopsis glabra
intro: Alsinopsis glabra, commonly known as Alangium, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and treating various infections due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alangium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have shown anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Alangium also exhibit immunomodulatory and hepatoprotective effects, making it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
